units.source_text: 声音和动作里都含着兴奋。

en.t: There was excitement in her voice and movements.

units.source_text: 男人估计错了，其实她倒显得极其兴高采烈。

en.t: The man had misjudged her; in fact, she seemed extraordinarily cheerful.

units.source_text: 男人像砂糖舔得过多似的，腻味起来。

en.t: The man began to feel sick of it, as though he had licked too much sugar.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，在擦身而过的时候，他还是会悄悄地在女人屁股上摸一把。

en.t: Even so, when they brushed past each other, he would still secretly give the woman a feel on the backside.

units.source_text: 不用说，电压过高，灯丝会烧断的。

en.t: Needless to say, if the voltage was too high, the filament would burn out.

units.source_text: 他决没有玩弄玩弄的打算。

en.t: He had absolutely no intention of merely playing around with her.

units.source_text: 他早晚会说给她听守护幻之城堡卫兵的故事。

en.t: Sooner or later, he would tell her the story of the guards who protected the phantom castle.
